descricao_produto: PRODUCT: one single long rectangular knitted bed runner (foot-of-bed throw) in solid sand beige (warm light beige, one uniform color, no second color, no stripes of another color). Proportion about 220 cm long by 60 cm wide, roughly 3.7 times longer than wide. Soft medium-thick tricot knit with matte yarn. Knit pattern: raised braided cable columns (slim plaited cables) alternating with wider bands of fine ribbed knit; the cables and the ribs run across the short width of the runner, from one long edge to the other, and repeat evenly along the whole length. The two long edges are slightly wavy, with a soft gentle ripple. The two short ends are plain, with no fringe, no tassels, no pom-poms. No logo, no tag, no label, no print, no embroidery. It lies flat across the foot of a double bed, perpendicular to the mattress length, and hangs down evenly over both sides of the bed.
